items.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
items.summary: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.

items.title: Anthropic Discloses Fourth Claude Hacking Incident as Debate Around Regulation Grows
items.summary: The company now says attacks during security tests exposed model behavior failures, after initially emphasizing errors in its testing infrastructure.

items.title: Coinbase, Moov to bring stablecoin payment infrastructure to community banks and credit unions
items.summary: The integration will use Coinbase's Payments API and custodial wallets to embed stablecoin rails into Moov's existing payments platform.
